# The Globe and Mail

> Canada's leading national newspaper covering politics, business, investing, world news, lifestyle, culture, sports, and real estate with in-depth analysis and breaking coverage.

The Globe and Mail is Canada's most influential news organization, delivering comprehensive coverage of Canadian politics, business markets (TSX, RBC), international affairs, and lifestyle topics. The site serves as a primary source for political analysis, investment information, and cultural commentary for Canadian audiences.

## Key Topics

- Canadian Politics
- Report on Business
- Stock Market & TSX
- Personal Finance
- World News
- Toronto Real Estate
- Sports Coverage
- Opinion & Analysis
- Lifestyle & Culture
- Breaking News
- Investment Ideas
- Government Policy
- Regional Coverage
- Entertainment Reviews
- Auto & Technology

## News & Politics

- [Canada](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada): Canadian news coverage: politics, crime, regional stories from Toronto, Vancouver
- [Politics](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/politics): Canadian politics: Pierre Poilievre, Conservative Party, federal/provincial news
- [World](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/world): World news: Iran, Ukraine, Middle East, Trump administration coverage
- [Opinion](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/opinion): Opinion: columnists Andrew Coyne, editorials, analysis on politics and policy

## Business & Investing

- [Report on Business](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business): Report on Business: breaking news, market analysis, TSX, RBC, finance
- [Globe Investor](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing): Globe Investor: stock market, TSX updates, investment ideas, personal finance
- [Personal Finance](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/personal-finance): Personal finance: retirement, tax planning, wealth management, housing

## Lifestyle & Culture

- [Life](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/life): Lifestyle section: health, food, travel, wellness, parenting, relationships
- [Culture](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/culture): Culture: books, TV, movies, music, theatre, entertainment reviews

## Property & Automotive

- [Real Estate](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/real-estate): Real estate: Toronto housing market, property trends, home sales analysis
- [Globe Drive](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/drive): Globe Drive: car reviews, electric vehicles, auto news, BMW, luxury cars

## Sports & Events

- [Sports](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/sports): Sports: Blue Jays, hockey, basketball, NFL, golf, Canadian teams coverage
- [Events](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/events): Events: Globe and Mail news events, forums, business and health topics

## Optional

- [Ad Choices](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/adchoices): Ad preferences and opt-out settings for interest-based advertising
